naming_rules.rule: XPS 4-digit code = 9 (premium XPS) + size digit (3=13.4", 4=14.5", 5=15.6", 6=16.3", 7=17") + generation digit + variant digit. Generation digit matches the model year's last digit for XPS 15/17/14/16 (9500=2020, 9510=2021, 9520=2022, 9530=2023, 9440/9640=2024) but NOT for XPS 13 (9300=Jan 2020, 9310=Sep 2020, 9315/9320=2022, 9340/9345/9350=2024; 9330 never existed). Dell publishes no decoder; this is derived from Dell model/launch data.

XPS last digit: 0 = mainline Intel model; 5 = alternate/derivative model of the same generation: 9305 = cheaper 16:9 older-chassis Tiger Lake XPS 13; 9315 = fanless Alder Lake-U XPS 13 (2022) next to 9320 XPS 13 Plus; 9345 = Snapdragon X Elite (ARM) XPS 13; 9350 = second 2024 Intel XPS 13 (Lunar Lake) after 9340 (Meteor Lake).

Older XPS used a 7xxx code for the 2019 models: XPS 13 7390 (Comet Lake, 16:9, succeeded 9380) and XPS 15 7590 (Coffee Lake-H). Warning: 'XPS 13 7390 2-in-1' is a different device (Ice Lake, 16:10) with the same code; likewise 'XPS 13 2-in-1 9310' and 'XPS 13 2-in-1 9315' share codes with the clamshells.

Inspiron (2020-2024): 1st digit = tier (3 = entry 3000, 5 = mainstream 5000, 7 = premium 7000 incl. 'Plus' and 2-in-1); 2nd digit = screen size (3=13.3", 4=14", 5=15.6", 6=16"); 3rd digit = model year last digit (0=2020 e.g. 5402/5502/3501, 1=2021, 2=2022, 3=2023, 4=2024); 4th digit = platform: 0 = Intel, 5 = AMD (5410/5415, 5420/5425, 5620/5625, 3530/3535 confirmed in Dell spec docs).

Inspiron 4th-digit exceptions: 1 = a second Intel platform or Qualcomm. Inspiron 15 3510 = Celeron/Pentium, 3511 = Core i3/i5/i7 (10th/11th gen), 3515 = AMD Ryzen. In 2024, xx41 = Snapdragon X (Inspiron 14 Plus 7441 = Snapdragon X Plus, 7440 = Intel Core Ultra).
Inspiron 2024 Qualcomm variant: Inspiron 14 Plus 7441 (Snapdragon X Plus, 54 Wh, 1.4 kg, $999.99) vs 7440 (Intel Core Ultra H, 64 Wh, 1.6 kg, $999.99).

Inspiron 7000-tier codes are shared by the 'Plus' clamshell and the 2-in-1 convertible of the same size/year (e.g. Inspiron 14 Plus 7420 vs Inspiron 14 7420 2-in-1; 14 Plus 7430 (H-series) vs 7430 2-in-1 (U-series); 16 Plus 7640 vs 16 7640 2-in-1). Check CPU suffix (H vs U) or form factor before pricing.
Since 2021 Dell dropped the 4-digit number from Inspiron marketing names ('Inspiron 14', 'Inspiron 16 Plus'); the code still appears on the label/service tag pages and in shop listings.

Pre-2020 Inspiron scheme: 1st digit series, 2nd digit screen size, 3rd digit = last digit of year (e.g. 5378 = 13" 2017, 5593 = 15" 2019), 4th digit = variant (per this source: 6 gaming, 8 2-in-1, 9 touch).

Dell G-series: G15 = 15.6", G16 = 16". Code = 5 (G15 tier) or 7 (G16 tier) + size digit + year digit (1=2021, 2=2022, 3=2023) + platform: 0 = Intel (5510 = 10th-gen Comet Lake-H), 1 = second Intel platform the same year (5511 = 11th-gen Tiger Lake-H; G15 5521 = 'Special Edition' 12th gen), 5 = AMD (5515 Ryzen 5000H, 5525 Ryzen 6000H, 5535 Ryzen 7040HS). G16 7620 = 12th-gen Intel H, 7630 = 13th-gen Intel HX.
G15 5521 SE exists alongside 5520 (12th gen Intel, launched 2022).

January 2025 rename (CES 2025): families Dell (consumer) / Dell Pro (business) / Dell Pro Max (workstation), each with tiers Base (no suffix) / Plus / Premium. Inspiron -> 'Dell' (base) and Inspiron Plus -> 'Dell Plus'; XPS -> 'Dell Premium'; Latitude -> Dell Pro; Precision -> Dell Pro Max; Alienware kept.
Dell 16 Plus (DB16250) is the direct successor of the Inspiron 16 Plus series.
Note: the XPS brand returned in 2026 after the 2025 rename (per Wikipedia).

2025 model codes: [family letter][tier letter][size 2 digits][year 2 digits][platform digit]. Family: D = Dell consumer, P = Dell Pro. Tier: A = Premium, B = Plus, C = base (Dell Pro also uses V = Essential, e.g. PV14250). Size 14/15/16. Year 25 = 2025. Platform 0 = Intel, 5 = AMD. Examples: DB14250 = Dell 14 Plus (Intel), DB14255 = Dell 14 Plus (AMD), DA14250 = Dell 14 Premium, DC14250 = Dell 14 (Intel), DC15255 = Dell 15 (AMD), PB14250 = Dell Pro 14 Plus. Dell publishes no decoder; derived from Dell document names.
Supporting Dell docs for the 2025 code scheme: Dell 14 DC14250 Intel brochure and Dell 14 Premium DA14250 spec sheet.
Caution: some 2025 base 'Dell 15' units (DC15250/DC15255) ship with older chips (Core i5-1334U, Core i7-1355U, Ryzen 7 7730U), so a 2025 code does not guarantee a 2025 CPU (VN shop listings).
